headline: GTA 6 is three days out and pre-sales are booming, a hard frost brings clear skies for Cavan tonight, and Vegas is next as Antonelli's champions' club piles up the points.

items.headline: US takes down North Korean deepfake-call crypto scheme
items.summary: US authorities seized the cloud infrastructure behind a campaign that used fake Zoom and Teams calls with deepfaked faces to steal more than $400 million in crypto.

items.headline: Thousands of vibe-coded Lovable apps left databases wide open
items.summary: Researchers found about 24,000 Lovable-built sites with Supabase databases readable without logging in, exposing passport scans and around 200,000 chat logs.

items.headline: Apple launches a 200,000-person study of AI health questions
items.summary: Apple and OpenEvidence opened a year-long US study app to track how iPhone users lean on AI for health advice.

items.headline: Lutnick joins Trump's China trip amid Nvidia chip-export row
items.summary: The Commerce Secretary is expected on the trip despite a clash with Treasury over blacklisting Megaspeed, with AI chip exports high on the agenda.

items.headline: Quiet day after the Starship catch
items.summary: No major new missions or discoveries since Saturday's first upper-stage catch. The next sky event worth staying up for is the Leonid meteor peak on Tuesday-Wednesday night.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: good, but cold
items.summary: Met Éireann expects most areas dry with long clear spells and a widespread frost (-3 to +1C); the rain warnings are for the west and south, not Cavan. The thin crescent Moon sets early. Dark from about 18:30, best viewing 19:00 to midnight before cloud creeps in from the southwest. Verdict: good. Wrap up.

items.headline: GTA 6 pre-sales far ahead of expectations, says Take-Two
items.summary: Three days before Thursday's console launch, Take-Two's boss says pre-orders are running well above forecasts. Still no PC date.

items.headline: GTA 6 Online may be a year away
items.summary: A Bloomberg documentary suggests the multiplayer mode will arrive roughly a year after launch; Rockstar hasn't confirmed it, so treat it as a rumour. Nothing new on the Witcher, Cyberpunk or Borderlands watchlist.

items.headline: Quiet start to the week; Polaris 40 on Saturday
items.summary: No major results overnight. Next up is Polaris 40 in Southampton, with Garry Tonon back in jiu-jitsu competition.

items.headline: UFC Qatar fight week: Prochazka vs unbeaten Stirling
items.summary: Saturday's Doha main event pits Jiri Prochazka against 11-0 Navajo Stirling, with the winner a likely next challenger for injured champion Carlos Ulberg.

items.headline: F1's five champions have scored more than half of 2026's points
items.summary: Champion Kimi Antonelli (390 points), Verstappen, Hamilton, Norris and Alonso hold almost 53% of all points scored this season, with Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi to go.

items.headline: Las Vegas schedule: another early-hours weekend
items.summary: Qualifying is at 04:00 Irish time on Saturday and the 50-lap race at 04:00 on Sunday; FP1 starts at 00:30 on Friday.
